# pvecli cluster tasks

Show cluster tasks.

```text
pvecli cluster tasks [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-r`, `--running` |  | Only show running tasks. |
| `-l`, `--limit N` | `50` | Maximum number of tasks. |
